headline: Consent hearing for 22-year lease for a Battery Storage Facility at 304 Concession 11 (PLB-2026-161)
summary: The Committee of Adjustment hears a consent application under section 50(3) of the Planning Act to allow a lease of about 22 years, possibly extended, for a Battery Storage Facility on Industrial (MG) zoned lands. The agenda notes an earlier approval (PLB-2024-134, August 20, 2024) lapsed because its conditions were not cleared within two years, so a new application was required.
evidence: the anticipated lease span of 22 years with the possibility of extending past that time period for the Battery Storage Facility on the subject lands

headline: Council receives Essex County advocacy for Hydro One investment and regional grid reliability
summary: The County of Essex's correspondence on advocacy for Hydro One infrastructure investment and regional power grid reliability was item 3 on the consent agenda. The minutes record the consent items as received (resolution 196/2026, carried). No further action is recorded.
